simple.meaning: לוּעַ (lûwaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to gulp ; figuratively, to be rash.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Job, Obadiah, beginning at Job 6:3. Its contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּעַ (H3886).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H3886. luwa ' [ לוּעַ , or לָעַע ] verb swallow, swallow down (Syriac , lap or lick up Judg 7:5-7 ); — Qal Perfect 3plural וְלָע֫וּ consecutive Obadiah 16 (Ges § 67 R. 12); — absolute, figurative of nations drinking (cup of judgment). — Hi De talk wildly , see II. לוע ; We Now נָעוּ reel, totter (compare Isa 24:20 ; 29:9 ). II. [ לוּע , or לָעַע ] verb talk wildly ( יָ֫לַע לָ֑עוּ ᵑ0 perhaps better would be יִ֫לַע לָעוּ֫, (√ לעה ), compare Thes and Arabic , make mistakes in talking , Ba ZMG xii. 1887, 605, 614 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine plural לָ֑עוּ Job 6:3 , subject דברים (see Di); Imperfect קֹדֶשׁ יָ֫לַע אָדָם מוֺקֵשׁ Prov 20:25 it is a snare to a man that he should rashly cry, Holy ! (construction unusual, and perhaps text, error, compare Frankenberg; on form see Ol § 243 a Anm ; Bö i. 296 Kö i. 375 f. derive from לעע ; Str., Hiph`il from לעע ). לוץ see ליץ .
